what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Afghanistan in Türkiye: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 47217 Afghan asylum seekers in Türkiye, 17.5% of all asylum seekers from Afghanistan.
Refugees from Afghanistan, a separate group, live mostly in Pakistan and Iran, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1995 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with the Taleban among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Afghanistan from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 46 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 164913, at the end of 2018, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Türkiye.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Türkiye only.
